questions.question:
A @ B means 'A is the husband of B'.

A & B means 'A is the daughter of B'.

A # B means 'A is the father of B'.

A % B means 'A is the sibling of B'.

If H @ K % M # P & S, then how is S related to K?
questions.solution:
A is

 
 
 

 
 
**Symbol**

 
 
 
@

 
 
 
&

 
 
 
#

 
 
 
%

 
 
 

 
 
**Meaning**

 
 
 
Husband

 
 
 
Daughter

 
 
 
Father

 
 
 
Sibling

 
 
 

 
 
to B

 
 
 

H @ K % M # P & S → H is husband of K, K is sibling of M, M is father of P, P is daughter of S.

By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/496368278e51fd33f2bee9b301a733a33389bdc9d0f2d4fae5af0b40056affd1.png]

Clearly, S is sister-in-law of K.

Hence, ‘**Sister-in-law**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All trees are walls.

No wall is a door.

Some doors are rooms.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some rooms are walls.

II. No trees are doors.

III. All walls are trees.

options.text: Only conclusions I and III follow
Only conclusions II and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c94440c29b147f037d3e19f3069036a2da44e0937fa788ab7899fe9f37ef498e.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some rooms are walls. → Does not follow (As, there is no definite relation between rooms and walls. Hence, false)

II. No trees are doors. → **Follows** (As, All trees are walls and No wall is a door, which implies no trees are doors)

III. All walls are trees. → Does not follow (As, All trees are walls, which implies some walls are trees)

Hence, ‘**Only conclusion II follows**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word. (The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word.)

Doctor: Hospital :: Engineer: ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** First word describes the person and second word describes the place where the person works.

 
• Doctor: Hospital → Doctors work in Hospitals.

Similarly,

 
• Engineer: ? → Engineers work at site.

Hence, '**Site**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the fourth number is related to the third number.

31 : 14 :: 23 : 10 :: 39 : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: **(Second number × 2) + 3 = Third number

 
• 31 : 14 → (14 × 2) + 3 = 28 + 3 = 31
 
• 23 : 10 → (10 × 2) + 3 = 20 + 3 = 23

Similarly,

 
• 39 : ? → (18 × 2) + 3 = 36 + 3 = 39

Hence, '**18**' is the correct answer.

Lion : Cave :: King : ________
questions.solution:

**Logic:** Second word is the name of the place where the first word lives.

Similarly,
